item.title: Fire-Damaged Building Condemned; Tenants Return For Clothes, Meds, Fish
item.description: A day after a fire displaced dozens of tenants from a five-story apartment building on Chapel Street, Punyam Bharadwaj returned to pick up a suitcase full of clothes, Andrew "Dre" Smedley grabbed his inhaler and his PlayStation 5, and Kyle hiked up five flights of stairs hoping that his fish had survived the night. item.title: High Bro’s Busted, Trades Smokes For Sports
item.description: "High Bro's" may still have a punny name about pot and video games -- as well as a mural depicting Luigi handing a joint to Mario. But according to a clerk, the Whalley shop has fully transitioned from selling cigarettes to sports memorabilia -- after cops found a half-pound of cannabis behind the counter. The post High Bro’s Busted, Trades Smokes For Sports appeared first on New Haven Independent.

item.title: The Pride Center Closes, For Now
item.description: Laura Glesby reports on the LGBTQIA+ community center's final hour open Wednesday. The Board of Directors will spend the next 30 days searching for the funding to keep the center going in some form, while staff have all been furloughed. The post The Pride Center Closes, For Now appeared first on New Haven Independent.
